content:
sara: heads up — found plaintext GCP SA key id inside a partner webhook payload in staging logs. payload also had a wrapped_blob reference. redacted payload and triaging now.

tom: where exactly in staging? can you paste a safe grep (no secrets) and the vault path if it's stored?

sara: grep: `logs-staging:/var/log/webhook/partner/*.log` matched entries with `service_account: partner-ingest@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `wrapped_blob: partner-wrap:v3` (blob only). vault path reading that consumer is `secret/data/partner/ingest`.

infra: immediate containment steps: 1) stop ingestion consumer in staging 2) snapshot current vault metadata + export audit events 3) request partner to rotate SA key and revoke old one 4) rewrap any ciphertext referencing the blob. who can run vault ops?

tom: I can handle vault ops. plan: snapshot metadata, enable request/response audit if not enabled, dry-run transit rewrap, then rewrap. commands:
```
vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/partner/ingest > /tmp/partner-ingest.meta
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key partner-wrap:v3 --dry-run
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key partner-wrap:v3
```
I'll run dry-run first.

vault-bot: audit: request/response logging already enabled on secret/data/partner at 2026-06-10T18:22:01Z.

sara: infra: I've paused the staging consumer (webhook-ingest-staging). tagging incident SEC-4921. notifying oncall. partner pinged and waiting on ack.

infra: good. also add a temporary Vault policy that restricts writes on that path except for platform-ops for the containment window. sample policy I propose:
```
path "secret/data/partner/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
path "secret/data/partner/ingest" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
path "secret/data/partner/ingest/rotate" {
  capabilities = ["update"]
  allowed_roles = ["platform-ops"]
}
```
apply as emergency policy.

tom: dry-run rewrap succeeded, no dependent errors. executing rewrap now and will update kv values to point to new ciphertext id.

infra: partner replied — they had the key in plaintext in their delivery logs and will rotate within 20m. asked for proof of rotation + old-key revocation.

devsec-bot: alert: 1 new occurrence matched webhook plaintext SA key pattern in logs-staging. Created SEC-4921 and attached evidence.

tom: rewrap done. updated secret/data/partner/ingest to reference new-wrap:v4. redeploying consumer with updated env var.

infra: redeploy started: webhook-ingest-staging v2026.06.10-rc1.

vault-bot: vault-audit: 17 requests to secret/data/partner/ingest recorded during the window. logs forwarded to splunk://index=sec-audit.

sara: infra, can you rotate any staging service account keys we own that allowed that webhook to talk to GCS? also push a network ACL to stop partner IPs from sending plaintext payloads to staging until we confirm.

infra: will rotate internal keys and add IP allowlist for staging ingestion endpoints ASAP. ETA 30m for keys.

tom: QA checked: consumer decrypts new ciphertext locally and integration tests pass. no obvious regressions in staging logs after restart.

sara: followups: 1) update partner onboarding doc to forbid sending plaintext keys in payloads 2) add a devex presubmit linter for payload patterns 3) run RBAC audit for vault paths accessible by partner identities 4) post-incident meeting and action owners in SEC-4921.

infra: noted. closing containment when partner provides rotation proof + we rotate our internal keys. will keep SEC-4921 open until confirmed.

tom: thanks all — marking ops tasks done on my end. will drop rewrap output to SEC-4921.
